releaseNotes: Fixed 'Source error' on sports streams: PPV, MethStreams, GStream24, SlapStreams and VoloKit. Streams whose host wants a Referer are now always played through the app's built-in relay (the hosts turned the box's player away with a 403), PPV asks for a fresh address when an edge refuses one, and VoloKit/MethStreams video hidden inside picture files is unpacked (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.39, Resolver 1.4.21). The PPV list no longer misses its window on a slow box (games' page sites are fetched ahead of time). Adult: hosts are no longer written off after one slow connect, Streamtape links resolve again, and the torrent site check works (cloudscraper added). PPV sports (and the other sports feeds on the same streaming edges) play again: their video is hidden inside picture files, and the check that unpacks it could be skipped after one slow answer, so the player was handed pictures it cannot read. Those streams are now always unpacked, a slow check no longer drops a source, and the relay asks again when an edge refuses a segment (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.36). New in Settings: Debug logging (On/Off) records what the player, sources and resolvers do, and Send log file uploads that log with keys and tokens removed and shows a short address to pass on (or saves it on the device if the upload services do not answer). Live TV: a channel that stays on 'loading' while its sound plays (the picture stays blank until the app is force-stopped) now gets a fresh player after 12 seconds before you are told it is taking too long. Fixed choosing a channel from a different category or section playing the channel that was already on (it needed a second try): the player was still using the old category's channel list. The TV Guide now opens on the last channel you watched (from Live TV, the guide or channel zapping), looking further down the list for it when needed. Fixed channels taking too long to load and playing sound only after changing the playback speed a few times: the replaced player kept its video decoder and the box ran out of video memory; it is now freed at once. Fixed the TV Shows, Anime, Sports and Settings widgets not loading: moving past a tab before it had finished loading marked it as loaded-and-empty for good (and it was kept that way for ten minutes); now a tab that was cut short or came back empty is loaded again the next time it is highlighted. Update downloads now use a file name that carries the version, so an update can never hand out an older copy from a download cache (the 32-bit box was served 1.16.8 as 1.16.9). Fixed the picture freezing while the sound plays on after choosing a speed: the video view stayed attached to the old player when the player was rebuilt. The old player is now stopped, the picture is attached to the new one, and the new one keeps the title's watch progress. Widgets load much faster. Favorites that come from a TMDB list are now kept on the device (and refreshed in the background) instead of being downloaded page by page every time; the Python side is started when the app opens instead of when the first widget needs it; the app no longer limits itself to 5 downloads at a time, which was queueing the ten pages of every list; and the Home widgets now appear one by one as each list arrives. Fixed the player closing right after a stream started (a stream that failed or stopped early was taken for a finished video; now only a video watched to its end returns to its widget or episode list). Fixed the speed button (1.25x/1.5x/1.75x) not changing the speed: your box sends the sound out untouched whatever the setting, which cannot be sped up, so choosing a speed now restarts the player at the same spot with the sound decoded by the app. Widgets load faster: Favorites and Continue Watching appear at once from what is on the device (before the Simkl/Trakt lists are asked for), and the Movies and TV Shows widgets appear one by one as each list arrives instead of all at the end. Fixed the player speed button (1.25x / 1.5x / 1.75x) not actually speeding the video up: audio passthrough and tunneled video are played untouched by the hardware, which cannot change speed, so choosing a speed now restarts the player at the same spot with the sound decoded by the app. The VLC engine now keeps the chosen speed when the stream (re)starts. When a movie ends it returns to that movie's widget, and when an episode ends it returns to that show's episode list (on the season that was playing). New setting, Settings > Play next episode: when on, the next episode starts by itself with the best source found. Backing out of a movie or show now returns to the widget row and poster it was opened from, not the Home position; the hub keeps its widgets so it comes back instantly. Favorites, Continue Watching and watchlist titles are now saved on the device too (kept through app updates), so those rows appear at once instead of waiting on the network. New playback speed button in the player controls: cycles 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x. The new HazMat TV icon and TV banner. Back now steps out one level at a time. In the player the first Back closes the control panel and the next leaves; a movie or show started from the Home widgets returns to that widget, in its section and on its poster; in Live TV Back goes channel, then categories, then the hub's Live TV section; in the TV Guide Back opens the groups, then returns to the hub; from anywhere in the hub Back goes to the Home position and one more Back exits the app. The Movies, TV Shows and Home lists are saved on the device and shown at once on the next start (and kept through app updates), then refreshed in the background every six hours. Fixed the TV Guide closing the app when a group was chosen. The Home carousels no longer stop at the first few titles: every favorite, every Continue Watching and watchlist title and ten pages of each TMDB list (New Releases, Top Rated, Popular, Upcoming...) are there. Live TV and the TV Guide use the same colors as the rest of the app. Coming back from a channel puts you on the channel you were watching, in the category you were in. The TV Guide is redesigned in the TiviMate style: a preview and program details at the top, channels down the left, a time line across; Left / Right move between programs, Up / Down between channels, OK plays, hold OK previews a live channel or sets a reminder, Left on the first program opens the groups. Movies and shows you have watched on Simkl or Trakt show a check mark (and their episodes in the episode list). The player has an Audio and subtitles picker (another audio track, other subtitles, or off), Left / Right skip during playback, and Down steps into the control bar (Left / Right move along it, OK presses a button, Up goes back to the picture); the bar stays up while you use it. Watched episodes (and movies) show a check mark, and sources are listed IPTV first, then best quality first, then most seeders. Movies and shows now list debrid sources (torrents and release-site hosters) once a debrid service is paired, and picking one plays it through your service. Pairing a premium service or tracker (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) shows a QR code next to the address and code, a service that does not answer the first time is retried, and finishing a pairing no longer shows a load error. Movies and TV Shows have a Favorites row, hold OK on a poster to add or remove a favorite, and Radio shows your Continue Watching and Favorites. HazMat TV is now built the Starfleet way: Home with widgets (highlight Movies, TV Shows, Live TV, Anime, Sports, Radio or Settings to see its widgets), autoplay trailers in English, Continue Watching, Favorites (on your profile or a TMDB list), cast with photos (open an actor to see everything they have been in), release and air dates, certification and the content advisory. Pair premium services and your trackers (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) in Settings; IPTV movies and shows are a source on every title and listed under IPTV Movies / IPTV TV Shows. Profiles, My Teams alerts (including the FloHockey leagues), split screen (side by side or top and bottom, mixing IPTV, movies and live sports), and Left / Right now skip back and forward during playback. Your IPTV providers, debrid pairings and trackers carry over from the old version. Needs Android 7 or newer.
